summary: Recommends a minimal set of transport services that end systems should offer and gives guidance on choosing among available mechanisms and protocols. It builds on the transport features in RFC 8303. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Programs need ways to send data, but there are many possible options. This document picks a small set of basic abilities that a good transport system should offer, and how to choose among them.

questions: what transport services should end systems provide
what is the minimal set of transport services
